shots.sourceText: Maya stands beside the white grand piano in her red tailored suit. The silver microphone remains on its stand beside the piano. Camera slowly pushes in.
shots.visualDirection: Maya stands beside the white grand piano in her red tailored suit. The silver microphone remains on its stand beside the piano.

shots.sourceText: Jules walks behind the same white grand piano while the silver microphone stays on its stand. Camera pans left with Jules.
shots.visualDirection: Jules walks behind the same white grand piano while the silver microphone stays on its stand.

shots.sourceText: Maya returns to the same white grand piano and reaches toward the silver microphone without moving its stand. Camera tracks right. On-screen text: STAY WITH ME.
shots.visualDirection: Maya returns to the same white grand piano and reaches toward the silver microphone without moving its stand.

shots.sourceText: Maya stands at the silver microphone while Jules sits at the same white grand piano. Maya keeps the red tailored suit and Jules keeps the navy jacket. Camera dollies backward.
shots.visualDirection: Maya stands at the silver microphone while Jules sits at the same white grand piano. Maya keeps the red tailored suit and Jules keeps the navy jacket.

references.name: Maya
references.description: Black woman with deep brown complexion, shoulder-length natural curls, and a red tailored suit.

references.name: Jules
references.description: Man with short dark hair wearing a navy jacket.

references.name: Approved piano setup
references.description: The white grand piano and silver microphone on its stand remain in the same positions. Jules is seated behind the piano in the approved project frame.
